programme.title: 30 for 30: Elway to Marino
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

However, over the millennia its contours changed and it was part of the process as Africa and Europe moved closer together. This process of formation, movement of continents and the emergence of new geographical features has created amazing natural phenomena. 2023

programme.title: d/f Fukushima: nature in the disaster zone
programme.desc: After the Fukushima disaster, many areas became dangerous for life, but some animals continue to exist in these conditions. Experts are sent to the disaster zone to study their adaptation to the toxic environment. This film will tell about how animals survive in a polluted area, and about what happens to nature after those terrible events. Dir.: Richard Max. Cast: Adam Hart. UK, 2021

programme.title: d/f Basic instinct. Continuation of the family. First male
programme.desc: The first male is the male in a group or community who has the opportunity to breed with females. This may be due to his physical characteristics (such as strength or size) or social status (such as leadership). Cast: Hwang Seok-chon. South Korea, 2021

programme.title: d/f Monkeys around: macaques of Huangshan Mountain
programme.desc: The Tibetan macaques of Huangshan Mountain face many challenges in harsh environments. This documentary project will explore how these animals adapt to life in the mountains, overcoming natural obstacles and maintaining a unique social hierarchy that helps them survive and thrive. 2019

programme.title: d/s On the verge of extinction. Madagascar
programme.desc: Every day, about 200 species of plants and animals leave the planet, accelerating the process of the sixth mass extinction. It is important to act to preserve biodiversity by protecting the natural centers of life that are located in different parts of the world. This project shows how life on Earth depends on the preservation of these ecosystems. UK, 2018

programme.title: Hard working animals. Jackals
programme.desc: The most elegant among the kidnappers are black-backed jackals. They live in Africa and make a living by taking advantage of everything the savannah has to offer. They are often found on the sidelines of banquets hosted by the most powerful inhabitants of the savannas - lions, vultures and hyenas. The black-backed jackal knows how to find the right moment. You need to be patient, judge the distance correctly and be fast. Stealing from a hyena or lion is a dangerous activity: one bite and a slow, painful death. In nature, not all thieves are as cunning and elegant as the black-backed jackal. Some animals look like gangsters. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. 8 p.
programme.desc: There is no life without death, which is why some creatures took on the role of gravediggers. Find out what strange methods they use to make bodies disappear. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: d/f Big little volcano
programme.desc: Tenerife is the largest island of the Canary archipelago and is home to several unique ecosystems. Around the Teide volcano live hundreds of species of animals and plants that have developed their own survival strategies. However, despite the unique nature, human presence creates a hidden threat to this beautiful corner. 2021

programme.title: d/f Beaver – superhero of the wild
d/s Wild Italy: top predators. Predators of the Tiber River
programme.desc: Two large waterfowl are experiencing a population boom that seems unstoppable. Italy, 2018

programme.title: d/s Superpowers of animals. Touch
programme.desc: A series that explores the amazing senses of animals and their evolution. Why do snakes have forked tongues and elephants have huge ears? How do bats and moths use their unusual ears and antennae for orientation? In each episode, we explore how these features, which at first glance seem strange, play a key role in survival. Like humans, animals rely on their senses to find food, communicate, and avoid danger. An in-depth look at how evolution has created unique tools to adapt to our environment. Dir.: Bettina Dalton, Max Serio. USA, Czech Republic, 2015

programme.title: d/s Water World of Komodo Island. Dragon Kingdom

Komodo dragons feel at home on mountain slopes, in forests and on the coast. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Germany, 2021

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild. Kingdom Rules

programme.title: d/s Living Nature. Waterfalls. Beauty and power of the elements
programme.desc: The waterfalls amaze with their power and beauty. These natural wonders not only create breathtaking landscapes, but also play an important role in ecosystems, forming unique landscapes. Director: Igor Falelyukhin. Russia, 2024

programme.title: d/s Living Nature. Animals. Book of Life
programme.desc: The animal world amazes with its diversity. Every creature is part of the great book of life, where everything is interconnected. By studying them, we better understand nature and our place in it. Director: Igor Falelyukhin. Russia, 2024

programme.title: d/f Life on the Rocks
programme.desc: The documentary dives into the world of mountain goats, known as the Lords of the Peaks. These incredibly resilient animals live in the harshest conditions and attract attention for their ability to survive in difficult situations. Study their habits and how they became the subject of legends and myths. The film will explore the challenges these animals face and what makes them symbols of endurance and strength. Spain, UK, 2020

programme.title: d/f Snakes. Secrets of the deadliest creatures on earth
programme.desc: In this program, snakes will show their inventive adaptation to life on earth. Among all animal species, only snakes have the ability to survive on land, in the sea, and even fly in the air. The show begins with a scene of ribbon snakes breeding after waking up from hibernation in Canada. You will learn a lot about the life cycles of Korean rat-catchers and vipers and the secret of flying snakes. A documentary team captured the flight of flying snake species. South Korea, 2014

programme.title: d/s Predatory instincts. 3 s.
programme.desc: The project immerses the viewer in the cruel but amazing world of wild nature, where every day is a struggle for life. Kill or be killed - these are the only rules of the game that animals obey. But how do they cope with these harsh conditions? How has evolution taught them to adapt and survive in a world full of dangers? Canada, 2019

programme.title: d/f Monfrague National Park
programme.desc: Monfrague is Extremadura's first protected natural area and is home to more than two hundred unique species of animals. This place attracts with its ecological significance, as rare birds such as black vultures and imperial eagles live here. These species are critically endangered and conservation of this natural heritage plays a vital role in preserving the region's biodiversity. Spain, 2023

programme.title: d/f Attenborough and the Mammoth Cemetery
programme.desc: Amateur archaeologists Sally and Neville Hollingworth, Sir David Attenborough and Professor Ben Garrod are joining forces to explore the largest Ice Age mammoth discovery in Britain. In this exciting project taking place near Swindon, the team explores the remains of a giant of the past, uncovering the secrets of his life and death, and the significance of these discoveries for understanding the history of the Ice Age. Starring: David Attenborough. UK, 2020

programme.title: d/f Transformation into a butterfly
programme.desc: The documentary takes you on a unique journey following a tiny caterpillar whose life is suddenly turned upside down by a hurricane. Left without a home, she must return to her lemon tree in just three days to complete the magical transformation. Every step she takes is a real feat, and meetings with other inhabitants of the forest become a test of strength and resourcefulness. France, 2021

programme.title: d/f Bees. Invisible mechanism
programme.desc: Our planet is facing the threat of an environmental crisis: the population of insects, including bees, is rapidly declining. The reasons for this are climate change, loss of natural habitat and overuse of pesticides. In this documentary, we explore how bees and other insects play a key role in maintaining ecosystems by pollinating plants and ensuring the yield of the fruits and vegetables we eat. Spain, 2022

programme.title: Adventure Namibia
programme.desc: Fascinating landscapes, an eventful history and breathtaking wildlife: Namibia - a country of extremes. This exciting region is one of the longed-for destinations for many adventurers. (Station info).

programme.title: Terra X

Skyscrapers in the cities show that Vietnam is a country between tradition and modernity. \n\nFilm author Iris Song travels from the north to the south, shows impressive aerial photos and environmental problems, but also reminds us of the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The bush aviators – adventures in the sky
programme.desc: In Suriname, bush pilots fly food, medicine and passengers over the country's jungles. In Norway, often only the seaplane can carry out special missions. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Andean condor Leslie poses a mystery to Taronga Zoo staff. Because the elegant bird of prey simply doesn't want to fly. Meanwhile, an orphaned wombat causes concern. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Love is in the air at Taronga Zoo. Does the romantic rendezvous between sea lions Charlie and Nala lead to new puppies? Meanwhile, giant tortoise Esmerelda is celebrating her 103rd birthday. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The monkeys are on the loose at Chester Zoo. Four orangutans have escaped from their enclosure. While the deserters are recaptured, the meerkat leader is contested for leadership. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Pregnant snakes, a baby giraffe's attempts to walk and the relationship between staff and animals - Chester Zoo shows unique footage that would otherwise remain hidden from visitors. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Orchid mantis Natasha has a huge appetite. After she has eaten almost all of the males, only Bruce is left. Will he manage to charm Natasha or will he end up as dessert? (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: All eyes in the zoo are on the pregnant giraffe Tula. The guards fear that she will have a stillbirth, like last year. Meanwhile, silver gibbon Eko learns to separate from his mother. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The dwarf otters Annie and Wallace have their paws full with their five children. On top of that, Baby Bo then disappears. Meanwhile, the chimpanzees get a new roommate. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Newborn elephant calf Indali tries to find her way in the herd at Chester Zoo. Meanwhile, forest dog Franco impregnates not only the dog Mana, but also her sister Japura. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The 32-year-old black rhino Kifaru is supposed to produce offspring for the zoo. While the senior struggles, the old porcupine Roxy recovers from the death of her long-time partner Hector. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The 13-year-old Okapi Stomp is supposed to mate with Lady K'tusha, but his horn becomes an obstacle. Meanwhile, there is competition between the wild dog brothers Ivar and Ville over a female. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: At the zoo, it's time for the polar bears to train their hunting skills. Meanwhile, a rare white rhinoceros is pregnant. Will the expectant mother save her species? (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: The orphaned koala cub Omeo finds loving new parents in the zookeepers at the San Diego Zoo. Meanwhile, a team travels to Kenya to test a specially developed elephant baby food. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: The hyena brothers Puru and Tuli will now share their living space with the lions of the San Diego Zoo. Meanwhile, the zookeepers are happy about the offspring of Mabel, the pygmy hippopotamus. (Station info).

programme.title: My journey with the elephants
programme.desc: For nine days, adventurer Levison Wood and tracker Kane Motswana trekked south with a herd of elephants. They watch which way the cops take. (Station info).

programme.title: Big cats
programme.desc: Groundbreaking insights, new approaches and discoveries: What is the leopard's greatest weapon? How can we use novel technologies to better understand big cats and protect them? (Station info).

programme.title: Africa: jaws and claws
programme.desc: Predators live in constant uncertainty: they never know where their next meal will come from. In order to survive, they must be prepared - evolution has produced sophisticated hunting techniques. (Station info).

programme.title: Chasing the rain
programme.desc: Three herds of elephants, three lead cows, one goal: to find water in an unprecedented drought. Will each of the experienced matriarchs be successful in their vital quest? (Station info).

programme.title: Großkatzen 24/7
programme.desc: On the edge of chaos, the lion pride struggles with hunger and rivalry. At the same time, a single cheetah defies the overwhelming army of lions. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: South of the Philippines, in central and eastern Indonesia, lies the so-called Coral Triangle. This underwater paradise is characterized by a particularly high level of biodiversity. To start: the Moluccas.

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: The Raja Ampat archipelago impresses with coral reefs, bizarre limestone islands and rare marine species. Salt lakes full of harmless jellyfish make the region a unique natural area. (Station info).

programme.title: Growing up in the wilderness
programme.desc: Young tigers, mountain gorillas and polar bears have to endure a tough fight for food and protection. Originally spoken by “Broadchurch” actor David Tennant. (Station info).

programme.title: Tricksters in the animal kingdom
programme.desc: Squids avoid their predators by adapting their color to their surroundings. Owls that live underground use a different tactic: they imitate the sounds of a rattlesnake. (Station info).

programme.title: Big Pacific: The Violent Ocean
programme.desc: Explorer Magellan called it the Pacific Ocean. He was wrong. In the Pacific, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions and cyclones can cause powerful turmoil. And while humans have already been to the moon, they have by no means uncovered all the secrets of the body of water, which at 166 million km² is larger than all of our planet's land areas combined. From tropical coral reefs to the water deserts of the open sea to dense kelp forests, animal inhabitants have conquered a wide variety of habitats. \n\nCamera teams filmed spectacles such as the meeting of sharks off the Colombian coast, the rise of countless glowing squids in Japan, and the great race of turtles to lay their eggs on Costa Rica's beaches. But also impressive tiny creatures like the hermit crab, which has made its home in the waste of civilization.

programme.title: Alpenflüsse
programme.desc: Spectacular images of Alpine rivers: They shape habitats, provide for animals and plants - and make people aware of how important water is for life in the mountains. (Station info).

programme.title: DIY SOS

programme.title: NHỮNG THIẾT KẾ HOÀNH TRÁNG - GRAND DESIGNS
programme.desc: Năm 2011, Edward và Hazel bắt đầu xây dựng một ngọn hải đăng trên bờ biển phía bắc Devon. Đến năm 2019, họ gần như phá sản chỉ còn bộ vỏ rỉ sét.

programme.title: JAMIE OLIVER: NẤU ĂN THEO MÙA - JAMIE OLIVER: SEASONS
programme.desc: Jamie ăn mừng món đại hoàng với nước sốt thơm ngon, làm nổi bật rau bina trong món risotto phô mai dê mềm mượt và kết hợp húng quế sống động với củ cải trong món cannelloni mùa xuân phô mai làm hài lòng đám đông

programme.title: CÁC MÓN ĂN DUBAI CỦA JASON ATHERTON - JASON ATHERTON'S DUBAI DISHES
programme.desc: Lần ra mắt đầu tiên của Jason ở Dubai thật thú vị khi anh khám phá một khu chợ truyền thống trong khu phố cổ, chỉ cho chúng ta cách thêm gia vị cho cuộc sống của mình và tham gia cùng đầu bếp địa phương Rahul Rana.

programme.title: THĂM THÚ PARIS CÙNG GUILLAUME - GUILLAUME'S PARIS
programme.desc: Guillaume tận hưởng những phần tốt đẹp hơn của cuộc sống Paris ở quận 7 và 8, bao gồm chuyến tham quan Tháp Eiffel và dùng bữa tại nhà hàng Jules Verne mang tính biểu tượng.

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: TRỪ BẠO AN LƯƠNG - PUNISH EVIL
programme.desc: Một lô hàng tiền mới phát hành bị ba tên cướp có vũ trang cướp, khiến thám tử Chang phải điều tra. Lần theo những manh mối mới, anh đã hạ gục thành công một trong những tên cướp. Trong khi đó, hai người còn lại âm mưu cướp một xưởng vàng giữa lúc hỗn loạn. Với kế hoạch tỉ mỉ, Chang đã phá vỡ âm mưu của họ và đưa họ ra trước công lý.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: TAY ĐẤM HUYỀN THOẠI - FIST OF LEGEND
programme.desc: Khi Chen Zhen học ở Nhật Bản, anh phát hiện một số sinh viên Trung Quốc mất tích và vô tình phát hiện ra âm mưu của Hội Rồng Đen. Một loại thuốc mới được phát minh để tăng cường sức khỏe cho quân đội Nhật Bản trong chiến tranh và các sinh viên Trung Quốc được sử dụng trong thí nghiệm của họ. Chen Zhen thề sẽ tiêu diệt tổ chức tà ác và phá hủy phòng thí nghiệm bí mật của chúng.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS

programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

Trong khi đó, hai người còn lại âm mưu cướp một xưởng vàng giữa lúc hỗn loạn. Với kế hoạch tỉ mỉ, Chang đã phá vỡ âm mưu của họ và đưa họ ra trước công lý.
